name: BITEZ Gummies 10,000mg Jarz - Mix n Match Variety Pack
description:
BUY 5, GET 1 FREE!

America's hottest selling hemp gummies just got a bundle deal worth stacking up on. Pick any 6 Double-Stacked (or Triple-Stacked) BITEZ Jarz from the full lineup and automatically GET THE 6TH JAR FREE! Each jar delivers 10 high-potency hemp gummies at 1,000mg per piece and 10,000mg total, loaded with a premium Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP cannabinoid blend that hits hard and lasts long.

With 20 bold, candy-inspired dual-layer (some triple-layer) flavors to choose from there's a BITEZ Jar for every craving in your rotation. Mix sweet, sour, fruity, and dessert-inspired high-potency hemp edibles and build the ultimate stash at the best possible price. Pick your 6. Stack your stash.
